terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.source: This website describes the waterproofing and tiling services provided by Ellis Services Group across Adelaide. It helps you choose a service and send a project enquiry.
terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.target: 本网站介绍 Ellis Services Group 在阿德莱德提供的防水与贴砖服务，帮助您选择服务并发送项目咨询。

terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.source: Website descriptions are general service information, not a project-specific quotation or construction specification. Our written quote confirms the work area, preparation, materials, inclusions, timing and price for your property. Any approved additional work is confirmed with you before proceeding.
terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.target: 网站介绍属于一般服务信息，并非针对项目的报价或施工规范。您的书面报价确认物业施工区域、准备、材料、包含内容、时间及价格。经同意的额外工作会在进行前与您确认。

terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.source: Submitting an enquiry starts the service enquiry process; it does not by itself confirm an appointment or authorise work. Booking, payment, cancellation and any warranty terms applicable to your project are set out in the agreed quote or contract. Your applicable consumer rights are not excluded by these website terms.
terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.target: 提交咨询表示开始服务沟通，本身不确认预约，也不授权施工。适用于项目的预约、付款、取消及保修条款，以双方确认的报价或合同为准。网站条款不排除您适用的消费者权利。

terms.html/html[1]/body[1]/main[2]/artic.source: Service imagery illustrates types of surfaces and finishes and is not presented as a record of an Ellis project unless expressly identified as such. External links, including maps, social media and public business records, are provided for convenience and operate under their own terms.
